svg.aria-label: TinyLlama's 32 rotary pairs drawn as dials, fastest first, each showing how far the pair turned over the 2,048 positions of training. The fast pairs on the left turned hundreds of times, so every angle is familiar to the model. The slow pairs on the right never completed one turn: past position 2,048 they point in directions the model has never seen. Colors mark what YaRN does to each pair when it stretches the context eight times: the fast pairs are left alone, the slowest are stretched in full, and those in between are blended

svg.text: TinyLlama's 32 rotary pairs over its 2,048 training positions
each dial is one pair of dimensions; the arc is how far it turned during training
number under a dial: turns in training
11 slowest pairs never finished a turn
